This substantial three-bedroom flat sits on the second floor of a classic red sandstone tenement, moments from the subway and a short stroll from the university, and it has been thoughtfully upgraded by its owners while keeping its period features. You enter through a tiled close with a restored wally dado, and the flat's wide reception hall gives access to every room, with two deep presses providing storage for coats and bicycles. The lounge faces the street through a three-part bay window and has working shutters, ornate cornicing and a cast-iron fireplace with a gas stove. To the rear, the dining kitchen has been fitted with shaker-style units, solid worktops, an electric range cooker, a dishwasher and a large fridge-freezer, and there is still room for a table that seats six. The main bedroom is a large double with built-in wardrobes and an en suite shower room with underfloor heating. The second bedroom is another good double, also with fitted wardrobes, and the third is a comfortable single that would work equally well as a home office. A family bathroom with a freestanding bath and a separate shower completes the accommodation. Outside, residents share a well-kept back court with a drying area and a lockable bike store, and on-street parking is by council permit. The flat is let unfurnished, with gas central heating and double glazing to the rear. Sorry, no smokers. Available now for a minimum term of twelve months, subject to references and a deposit equal to five weeks' rent.
